observations.content:
# SDD Specs for mvp-generation-fase1

## Domain: mvp-generation (NEW)

### Requirement: Demo Generation Trigger
`POST /api/generate-demo/{cotizacion_id}` MUST accept `selection_ids` (1-2 valid solutions) and `business_data` (nombre + sector required). Returns 202 Accepted with async `deployment_id`.

#### Scenario: Valid generation request with 2 solutions
- GIVEN cotización `cot-42` and client selected "fidelizacion-wallet" + "menu-digital"
- WHEN `POST /api/generate-demo/cot-42` with valid `selection_ids` and `business_data`
- THEN returns 202 with `{ status: "generating", deployment_id, estimated_seconds, check_status_url }`

#### Scenario: Request with empty selection_ids
- GIVEN a valid cotización
- WHEN `POST /api/generate-demo/{id}` with `selection_ids: []`
- THEN returns 400 with `{ error: "selection_ids_must_have_1_to_2_items" }`

#### Scenario: Request with more than 2 solutions
- GIVEN a valid cotización
- WHEN `POST /api/generate-demo/{id}` with `selection_ids` containing 3 items
- THEN returns 400 with `{ error: "selection_ids_must_have_1_to_2_items" }`

#### Scenario: Request with unknown solution ID
- GIVEN a valid cotización
- WHEN `POST /api/generate-demo/{id}` with `selection_ids: ["unknown-solution"]`
- THEN returns 400 with `{ error: "unknown_solution", detail: "unknown-solution" }`

#### Scenario: Missing required business_data fields
- GIVEN a valid cotización
- WHEN `POST` with `business_data: { sector: "Restaurante" }` (missing `nombre`)
- THEN returns 400 with `{ error: "business_data_nombre_required" }`

### Requirement: Deployment Status Polling
`GET /api/generate-demo/{deployment_id}/status` MUST return current deployment state. On `ready`, includes `demo_url`, `preview_token`, and `expires_at`.

#### Scenario: Deployment is generating
- GIVEN deployment `dep-xyz` in `generating` status
- WHEN `GET /api/generate-demo/dep-xyz/status`
- THEN returns `{ status: "generating" }`

#### Scenario: Deployment is ready
- GIVEN deployment `dep-xyz` completed successfully
- WHEN `GET /api/generate-demo/dep-xyz/status`
- THEN returns `{ status: "ready", demo_url, preview_token, expires_at, stats }`

#### Scenario: Deployment failed
- GIVEN deployment `dep-xyz` encountered build error
- WHEN `GET /api/generate-demo/dep-xyz/status`
- THEN returns `{ status: "failed", error_message }`

#### Scenario: Unknown deployment ID
- GIVEN no deployment with ID `dep-nonexistent`
- WHEN `GET /api/generate-demo/dep-nonexistent/status`
- THEN returns 404 with `{ error: "deployment_not_found" }`

### Requirement: Booking-to-Demo Integration
When booking completes (2 solutions, meeting scheduled, email confirmed), the system SHALL auto-trigger `POST /api/generate-demo/{cotizacion_id}`.

#### Scenario: Automatic trigger on booking confirmation
- GIVEN client selected 2 solutions and confirmed meeting for `cot-42`
- WHEN booking confirmation completes
- THEN system triggers `POST /api/generate-demo/cot-42` and saves `deployment_id` to cotización

#### Scenario: Post-booking "Ver Demo" button
- GIVEN booking confirmed and demo triggered for `cot-42`
- WHEN client views dashboard or SolutionSelector
- THEN "Ver Demo" button polls status every 5s until `ready` or `failed`

#### Scenario: Demo generation exceeds SLA
- GIVEN deployment >5min and still `generating`
- WHEN client views "Ver Demo" button
- THEN shows "Preparando tu demo..." with spinner and estimated wait time

---

## Domain: preview-token (NEW)

### Requirement: Token Generation
A 32-character random preview token MUST be generated at deployment time and stored in `mvp_deployments.preview_token`.

#### Scenario: Token generated on deployment creation
- GIVEN new deployment created for `cot-42`
- WHEN deployment record inserted into `mvp_deployments`
- THEN `preview_token` populated with 32-char URL-safe random string

#### Scenario: Token is unique per deployment
- GIVEN existing deployment with `preview_token: "abc123..."`
- WHEN new deployment created
- THEN new token MUST NOT match any existing active token

### Requirement: Token Expiration
Tokens MUST expire automatically 7 calendar days after `generated_at`.

#### Scenario: Token valid within 7 days
- GIVEN `generated_at` is 2026-06-24 and today is 2026-06-30
- WHEN client accesses demo URL with preview token
- THEN demo content displayed with preview banner

#### Scenario: Token expired after 7 days
- GIVEN `generated_at` is 2026-06-24 and today is 2026-07-01
- WHEN client accesses demo URL
- THEN shows "Esta demostración ha expirado" and demo content NOT displayed

### Requirement: Token Validation on Access
Demo frontend MUST validate token on mount by checking `expires_at`. Expired/invalid token SHALL block access.

#### Scenario: Token validated on page load
- GIVEN demo page loads with `?token=abc123...`
- WHEN frontend validates `expires_at` client-side and token is not expired
- THEN demo renders with preview banner

#### Scenario: Missing token in URL
- GIVEN demo URL has no `?token=` parameter
- WHEN page loads
- THEN shows "Token de vista previa no encontrado" and no demo content

#### Scenario: Token does not match any deployment
- GIVEN token exists in no `mvp_deployments` record
- WHEN page validates token
- THEN shows "Token inválido" and no demo content

### Requirement: Preview Banner and CTA
Demo UI MUST display persistent non-hideable banner "Esta es una demostración" with "Contáctame para versión producción" CTA.

#### Scenario: Banner always visible on valid demo
- GIVEN valid non-expired token
- WHEN demo page renders
- THEN fixed banner "Esta es una demostración" with no dismiss button, plus CTA button

#### Scenario: Banner persists across navigation
- GIVEN client viewing demo
- WHEN navigating between sections
- THEN banner remains visible and CTA button stays accessible

---

## Domain: template-deployment (NEW)

### Requirement: Template Repository Structure
Each of 4 solutions MUST have pre-built template with Next.js 14+, Tailwind, Shadcn/ui, mock data, and `config.ts` with placeholders.

#### Scenario: Template contains required placeholders
- GIVEN `template-fidelizacion-wallet` repository
- WHEN inspecting `config.ts`
- THEN contains `{{BUSINESS_NAME}}`, `{{SECTOR}}`, `{{CLIENT_EMAIL}}`, `{{PRIMARY_COLOR}}`, `{{SECONDARY_COLOR}}`, `{{PREVIEW_TOKEN}}`, `{{EXPIRES_AT}}`

#### Scenario: Each template is self-contained and deployable
- GIVEN any of 4 template repos
- WHEN built after placeholder substitution
- THEN build succeeds for Cloudflare Pages

#### Scenario: Template content matches solution domain
- GIVEN each template, THEN content matches: wallet=loyalty+points+history+referral, menu=categories+search+cart, dashboard=KPIs+charts+table+darkmode, whatsapp=chat+bot+quickreplies

### Requirement: Config Personalization
CF Worker MUST clone template, replace all placeholders in `config.ts` with business_data values.

#### Scenario: Business data replaces placeholders
- GIVEN `business_data: { nombre: "La Parrilla", sector: "Restaurante", email, colors }`
- WHEN CF Worker personalizes `config.ts`
- THEN `{{BUSINESS_NAME}}` → "La Parrilla", `{{PREVIEW_TOKEN}}` → new 32-char token, `{{EXPIRES_AT}}` → +7 days ISO

#### Scenario: Missing optional colors fall back to defaults
- GIVEN `business_data` has no `colors`
- WHEN CF Worker personalizes `config.ts`
- THEN `{{PRIMARY_COLOR}}` → default #3B82F6, `{{SECONDARY_COLOR}}` → default #10B981

### Requirement: mvp_deployments Table Storage
`mvp_deployments` MUST store: id (UUID PK), cotizacion_id (FK), solution_ids (TEXT[], 1-2), deployment_id (UNIQUE), status, stats. Indexes on cotizacion_id, deployment_id, expires_at, status.

#### Scenario: Deployment record created on generation request
- GIVEN valid `POST /api/generate-demo/cot-42`
- WHEN request accepted
- THEN row inserted with `status: "generating"`, valid solution_ids, unique deployment_id

#### Scenario: Constraint violation on duplicate deployment_id
- GIVEN `dep-abc` already exists
- WHEN inserting another row with `deployment_id: "dep-abc"`
- THEN database rejects with unique constraint violation

#### Scenario: Status transitions across lifecycle
- GIVEN deployment `status: "generating"`
- WHEN build+deploy succeeds → `status` → `ready`
- WHEN 7 days elapse → `status` → `expired`

#### Scenario: Stats tracking on demo access
- GIVEN deployment with 0 views
- WHEN client opens demo URL
- THEN `view_count` increments, `last_viewed_at` updates, `sections_viewed` accumulates

---

## Domain: meeting-scheduling (DELTA)

### ADDED: Post-Booking "Ver Demo" State
After booking confirmation and demo trigger, SolutionSelector and dashboard SHALL display "Ver Demo" button navigating to demo URL.

#### Scenario: "Ver Demo" button appears after booking confirmation
- GIVEN client confirmed meeting with 2 solutions for `cot-42`
- WHEN client views SolutionSelector/dashboard
- THEN "Ver Demo" button displayed

#### Scenario: Button shows generating state
- GIVEN deployment `status: "generating"`
- WHEN client views button
- THEN shows "Preparando demo..." with spinner, not clickable

#### Scenario: Button becomes active when ready
- GIVEN button showing "Preparando demo..."
- WHEN polling returns `status: "ready"`
- THEN becomes "Ver Demo", clickable, opens `demo_url` in new tab

#### Scenario: Button shows error state on failure
- GIVEN deployment `status: "failed"`
- WHEN client views button
- THEN shows "Error al generar demo" with "Reintentar" option

#### Scenario: Button shows expired state after 7 days
- GIVEN deployment past `expires_at`
- WHEN client views button
- THEN shows "Demo expirada", disabled, tooltip "Esta demostración ya no está disponible"

#### Scenario: Polling stops after terminal state
- GIVEN button polling every 5s
- WHEN status → `ready` or `failed`
- THEN polling stops, button reflects final state permanently

#### Scenario: No "Ver Demo" button before booking confirmed

observations.title: sdd/mvp-generation-fase1/design
observations.content:
# Design: MVP Demo Generation (FASE 1)

## Technical Approach

**Option A**: Pre-built static HTML/CSS bundles in Supabase Storage, personalized via string replacement, deployed to Cloudflare Pages. No build step — zero CI wait.

`POST /api/generate-demo/{cotizacion_id}` fetches up to 2 template bundles, replaces `{{PLACEHOLDER}}` variables with business data, generates a preview token, deploys, and returns 202. Frontend polls `GET .../status` every 5s. Templates are static HTML with embedded CSS/JS — no framework, no npm, no GitHub cloning.

## Architecture Decisions

### Decision 1: Option A (Static Bundles) vs Option B (Full Repos)

|  | Option A | Option B |
|--|----------|----------|
| Build step | None (string replace) | `npm run build` (~90s) |
| Storage | Supabase Storage | GitHub repos + clone |
| SLA | < 30s achievable | 3–5 min risk |
| Complexity | Low | High |

**Choice**: Option A. Sub-300s SLA is hard requirement (success criteria #1). Option A personalizes in memory and deploys in under 10s. Versioning/template editing out of scope for FASE 1.

### Decision 2: API Route vs Separate CF Worker

**Choice**: Next.js API route. The endpoint needs Supabase Storage (fetch templates) and database (write `mvp_deployments`). A Next.js route already has `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` via server env. The CF Pages deploy call is a single REST API call — no Worker needed.

### Decision 3: Cloudflare Pages Direct Upload

**Choice**: Direct REST API (`POST /pages/projects/{name}/deployments`) with a ZIP bundle. Subdomain: `demo-{cotizacion_id}.operativadigital.dev`. Static HTML served directly — no build framework required.

### Decision 4: Token Design

**Choice**: 32-char URL-safe random string via `crypto.randomUUID()` (dashes → underscores). UNIQUE constraint in DB. Expiration checked client-side (template embeds `EXPIRES_AT`) and server-side on status poll. Opaque lookup keys, not JWT.

## Data Flow

```
SolutionSelector (booking confirmed)
        │
        ▼ POST /api/generate-demo/{cotizacion_id}
        │ body: { selection_ids, business_data }
        │
  [API Route] ──► Validate input + solution slugs
        │            (against experience-base.json IDs)
        │
        ├──► INSERT mvp_deployments (status: generating)
        │
        ├──► FETCH templates from Supabase Storage
        │        mvp-templates/{solution}/index.html + assets/
        │
        ├──► REPLACE: {{BUSINESS_NAME}}, {{SECTOR}}, {{PRIMARY_COLOR}},
        │        {{PREVIEW_TOKEN}}, {{EXPIRES_AT}}, {{DEMO_URL}}
        │
        ├──► ZIP → CF Pages API → deploy
        │
        ├──► UPDATE mvp_deployments (status: ready, demo_url)
        │
        └──► RETURN 202 { deployment_id, check_status_url }

SolutionSelector ──► poll GET .../status every 5s
        │              └──► ready → navigate to demo_url?token=...
        └──► "Ver Demo" button (generating → loading spinner)
```

## File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `src/app/api/generate-demo/[cotizacion_id]/route.ts` | Create | POST trigger + GET status handler |
| `src/app/api/generate-demo/[cotizacion_id]/__tests__/route.test.ts` | Create | API integration tests |
| `src/lib/demo-generator.ts` | Create | Template fetch, placeholder replace, CF Pages deploy |
| `src/lib/preview-token.ts` | Create | Token gen (32-char) + expiration validation |
| `supabase/migrations/20260624_mvp_deployments.sql` | Create | DDL + indexes + RLS |
| `src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx` | Modify | Add `deploymentState`, "Ver Demo" button with 5s poll |
| `supabase/schema.sql` | Modify | Append `mvp_deployments` DDL |
| `.env.example` | Modify | Add `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` |

## Database Schema

```sql
CREATE TYPE deployment_status AS ENUM ('generating', 'ready', 'failed', 'expired');

CREATE TABLE mvp_deployments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  cotizacion_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES selections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  solution_ids TEXT[] NOT NULL CHECK (array_length(solution_ids, 1) BETWEEN 1 AND 2),
  deployment_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  status deployment_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generating',
  demo_url TEXT,
  preview_token TEXT UNIQUE,
  generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  stats JSONB DEFAULT '{"view_count":0,"sections_viewed":[]}',
  error_message TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_mvp_deployments_cotizacion ON mvp_deployments(cotizacion_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_mvp_deployments_status ON mvp_deployments(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_mvp_deployments_expires ON mvp_deployments(expires_at);
```

**RLS**: `service_role` full access; `authenticated` read-only on `demo_url`, `preview_token`, `status`, `expires_at`; `anon` validates token via dedicated function.

## Error Handling

| Failure | HTTP | Response |
|---------|------|----------|
| Empty selection_ids | 400 | `{ error: "selection_ids_must_have_1_to_2_items" }` |
| Unknown solution slug | 400 | `{ error: "unknown_solution", detail }` |
| Missing business_data.nombre | 400 | `{ error: "business_data_nombre_required" }` |
| CF Pages deploy fails | 500 → db:failed | `{ status: "failed", error_message }` |
| Unknown deployment_id | 404 | `{ error: "deployment_not_found" }` |

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What | Approach |
|-------|------|----------|
| Unit | `preview-token.ts` (gen, validate) | Vitest, pure functions |
| Integration | `demo-generator.ts` (replace, validate) | Vitest + mocked fetch |
| API | `route.ts` (202, status, errors) | Vitest + mocked demo-generator |
| Component | SolutionSelector button states | @testing-library/react |

## Open Questions

- [ ] Is `selections.id` the canonical "cotización"? Proposal says `cotizacion_id` but schema uses `selections`. Use `selections.id` internally, expose `cotizacion_id` in URLs.

observations.title: sdd/payment-contracts-fase2/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Payment Contracts — Fase 2

## Intent

Enable payment collection after proposal approval: charge 60% upfront via Stripe Checkout, deliver the product, then collect the remaining 40%. Automate contract generation (PDF), confirmation emails, and admin payment tracking.

## Scope

### In Scope
- Stripe Checkout Session integration (60% advance + 40% final)
- Stripe webhook handler (`POST /api/webhooks/stripe`)
- `payments` table in Supabase schema
- `POST /api/payments/{cotizacion_id}/checkout` endpoint
- Auto-generated contract PDF (jspdf + jspdf-autotable)
- Payment confirmation emails (Resend — 60% and 40% templates)
- Admin payments dashboard (pending, history, conversion rate)
- Refund management (partial/full)
- Webhook signature validation + IP security checks

### Out of Scope
- Digital signatures (Fase 3)
- Multi-currency (USD only)
- Recurring/subscriptions
- Apple Pay / Google Pay (card-only MVP)

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `payment-checkout`: Stripe Checkout Session creation, 60% advance flow
- `payment-webhooks`: Stripe event ingestion, payment status sync, signature validation
- `contract-generation`: PDF contract with jspdf, terms, payment schedule, support clauses
- `payment-email`: Resend integration, 60% and 40% confirmation templates
- `payment-dashboard`: Admin view — pending payments, history, conversion metrics
- `payment-refunds`: Partial/full refund via Stripe API, status tracking

### Modified Capabilities
None — all payment domains are new; no existing spec requirements change.

## Approach

Next.js 16 App Router API routes for checkout and webhooks. Stripe SDK creates Checkout Sessions targeting the 60%/40% split. Webhook handler validates `stripe-signature` header, updates `payments` table, triggers contract generation and emails. Admin dashboard consumes Supabase queries with conversion-rate aggregation.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `src/app/api/payments/[cotizacion_id]/checkout/` | New | Checkout session endpoint |
| `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/` | New | Stripe webhook handler |
| `src/app/admin/payments/` | New | Admin payments dashboard |
| `src/lib/stripe.ts` | New | Stripe SDK client wrapper |
| `src/lib/resend.ts` | New | Resend email client wrapper |
| `src/lib/contract/` | New | jspdf contract generation |
| `supabase/migrations/` | New | `payments` table + RLS policies |
| `package.json` | Modified | Add stripe, @stripe/stripe-js, resend, jspdf, jspdf-autotable |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Stripe webhook idempotency (duplicate events) | Med | Idempotency key on `stripe_event_id` UNIQUE constraint |
| Webhook timeout before contract generation completes | Low | Async queue — acknowledge webhook first, generate contract second |
| jspdf rendering in edge runtime | Low | Validate jspdf + jspdf-autotable Node.js compat; fallback to API route config `runtime: "nodejs"` |
| Partial refund edge cases (currency decimals) | Low | Stripe SDK handles amount precision; test with cents-based amounts |

## Rollback Plan

1. Disable Stripe webhook endpoint in Stripe Dashboard
2. Remove `src/app/api/payments/` and `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/` routes
3. Drop `payments` table via migration rollback
4. Revert `package.json` dependency additions (stripe, resend, jspdf)
5. Remove admin dashboard route `src/app/admin/payments/`

## Dependencies

- Stripe account (test mode keys for dev, live for prod)
- Resend account (verified sending domain)
- Supabase project with RLS enabled
- Existing cotización flow from Fase 1 (`customer-onboarding`, `service-quoting`, `mvp-generation`)

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `POST /api/payments/{cotizacion_id}/checkout` creates a Stripe Checkout Session and returns the URL
- [ ] Stripe webhook processes `checkout.session.completed` and updates `payments` table
- [ ] 60% payment triggers confirmation email with next-steps template
- [ ] 40% payment trigger auto-generates support contract PDF
- [ ] Admin dashboard shows pending payments, completed history, and conversion rate
- [ ] Partial refund creates a refund record and updates payment status correctly
- [ ] All API routes protected by webhook signature (Stripe) or auth (admin)

observations.title: sdd/payment-contracts-fase2/spec
observations.content:
# SDD Specs: payment-contracts-fase2

## payment-checkout

### Requirement: Checkout Session Creation
MUST create Stripe Checkout Session at 60% of cotización total.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valid checkout | cotización total_usd=1000 | POST with customer_email, customer_name | 201, checkout_url, payment_intent_id, client_secret, status "pending" |
| 60% cents calc | total_usd=997.50 | checkout requested | amount_60_cents=59850 (rounded down) |
| Missing fields | valid cotización | request omits customer_email | 400 "customer_email is required" |
| Invalid amount | total_usd=0 or NULL | checkout requested | 400 "total must be greater than zero" |
| Cotización not found | non-existent id | checkout requested | 404 "cotización not found" |
| Stripe API error | valid request, Stripe unreachable | checkout requested | 502, no payment record created |

### Requirement: Idempotency
MUST prevent duplicate sessions for same cotización.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Duplicate checkout | existing "pending"/"paid_60" payment | checkout again | 409 with existing checkout_url |

---

## payment-webhooks

### Requirement: Webhook Signature Validation
MUST validate Stripe-Signature header.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valid signature | valid signature + raw body | POST /api/webhooks/stripe | event processed |
| Invalid signature | tampered/missing signature | webhook received | 400 "invalid signature", not processed |
| Missing header | no Stripe-Signature | webhook received | 400 "missing signature header" |

### Requirement: Payment Intent Succeeded
MUST update to "paid_60", record charge_id, trigger email.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Successful 60% | payment "pending", matching payment_intent_id | payment_intent.succeeded webhook | status="paid_60", charge_id/paid_60_at recorded, email queued, 200 |

### Requirement: Payment Failed
MUST set status="failed".

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Payment failure | payment "pending" | payment_intent.payment_failed | status="failed", 200, no email |

### Requirement: Charge Refunded
MUST set status="refunded".

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full refund | payment "paid_60"/"paid_100", matching charge_id | charge.refunded | status="refunded", 200 |
| Unknown event | unhandled type (payment_intent.created) | webhook received | 200, no modification |

### Requirement: Duplicate Event Handling
MUST ignore duplicates via stripe_event_id.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Duplicate event | already-processed event | same event received again | 200, no state change |

---

## contract-generation

### Requirement: PDF Contract Generation
MUST generate A4 PDF via jspdf, save to Supabase Storage "contracts" bucket.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valid generation | payment "paid_60", customer details | contract triggered | PDF with dark-mode A4, uploaded, contract_id + pdf_url returned |
| 60/40 split | total_usd=2000 | PDF generated | "60% Advance: $1,200.00", "40% Final: $800.00", both milestones listed |
| Signature placeholders | generated contract | PDF rendered | "Client" + "Service Provider" blocks with date lines |
| Terms included | generated contract | rendered | Support Terms + Cancellation Policy sections, CONT-{YYYYMMDD}-{random6} format |
| Storage failure | PDF generated | upload fails | 502 "contract storage failed", retry on next attempt |
| Missing optional | NULL customer_name/services | generation | "N/A" placeholders, PDF still completes |

### Requirement: Unicode & Edge Cases
MUST handle Unicode, long names, special chars.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Long text | business name >80 chars | rendered in header | wraps without layout break |

---

## payment-email

### Requirement: 60% Confirmation
MUST send via Resend from hola@juancode.dev.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60% email | payment "paid_60", customer_email/name | dispatched | subject "Payment Confirmed — Next Steps", amount + contact info |

### Requirement: 40% Final Email
MUST send delivery confirmation with credentials.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40% email | payment "paid_100", customer_email, contract_id | dispatched | credentials + contract link, "Delivery Confirmed — Your Access Credentials" |

### Requirement: Error Handling
MUST not block payment flow on email failure.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Resend failure | payment→"paid_60", Resend unreachable | dispatch attempted | status commits, failure logged, 200 returned |
| Invalid email | NULL/malformed customer_email | dispatch attempted | "email skipped: invalid recipient" logged, no API call |
| Both milestones | same customer, 60%+40% paid | each milestone email | 60% email omits credentials, 40% includes credentials |

---

## payment-dashboard

### Requirement: Admin Auth
MUST require admin authentication.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unauthenticated | no auth | GET /api/admin/payments | 401 "authentication required" |
| Non-admin | authenticated, no admin role | GET /api/admin/payments | 403 "admin access required" |

### Requirement: Payment List
MUST return paginated, filterable list.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pending filter | 5 pending, 3 paid_60 | ?status=pending (admin) | 5 pending only, with client_name, amount, status, checkout_url |
| All payments | various statuses | no filter (admin) | all payments, most recent first |
| Empty state | no payments | dashboard loaded | empty array, total_collected=0, pending_amount=0 |

### Requirement: Conversion Metrics
MUST calculate aggregate metrics.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Conversion rate | 10 total: 6 paid, 4 pending/failed | metrics computed | conversion_rate=0.60, total_collected=sum paid, pending_amount=sum pending |
| No completions | all "pending" | metrics computed | conversion_rate=0.00, total_collected=0 |

---

## payment-refunds

### Requirement: Refund Processing
MUST process via Stripe Refund API.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full refund | payment "paid_60", amount=60000 | refund 60000 | Stripe full refund, status="refunded", 200 with refund_id |
| Partial refund | payment "paid_60", amount=60000 | refund 30000 | Stripe partial refund, status stays "paid_60", partial_refund_amount recorded |
| Amount exceeds paid | amount=60000 | refund 70000 | 400 "refund amount exceeds paid amount", no Stripe call |
| Already refunded | status="refunded" | refund requested | 409 "payment already refunded" |
| Stripe error | valid request | Stripe API error | 502 with Stripe message, DB unchanged |

### Requirement: Refund Email
MUST send confirmation via Resend on successful refund.

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Refund email | successful refund | Stripe confirms | Resend email with amount, reference, contact info |
| Email failure | successful refund, Resend down | dispatch fails | refund committed, failure logged for manual follow-up |

observations.title: sdd/payment-contracts-fase2/design
observations.content:
# Design: Payment Contracts — Fase 2

## Technical Approach

Next.js 16 App Router API routes integrating Stripe Checkout (60% advance) and Resend email. New `payments` table with RLS policies. jspdf (already in project) generates the contract PDF on 60% payment success. Follow established project conventions: direct `createClient` + service-role for DB writes, `fetch()` to Resend (matching `send-proposal` pattern), and Spanish header comments with English error codes (matching `generate-demo` pattern).

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Options | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|---------|--------|-----------|
| Stripe client | `stripe` Node SDK vs raw `fetch` | **SDK** | `stripe.paymentIntents.create()` is simpler than constructing raw API calls; SDK handles idempotency keys, types, and edge versions |
| Webhook body parsing | `request.text()` (raw) vs `request.json()` | **Raw body** | Stripe signature validation requires the exact raw body; `request.json()` mutates the stream |
| Contract PDF | jspdf (already in deps) vs puppeteer/html-to-pdf | **jspdf** | Already in `package.json`, matching `pdf-generator.ts` pattern; no server runtime to launch headless Chrome |
| Resend client | `resend` SDK vs `fetch()` to REST API | **fetch()** | Matches existing `send-proposal` route pattern; avoids extra dependency; simpler |
| Email dispatch timing | Sync inside webhook handler vs fire-and-forget | **Fire-and-forget** | Proposal risk mitigation: webhook must acknowledge within Stripe's timeout; email failure must not cascade |
| Admin auth guard | Supabase Auth RLS on table vs API route middleware | **Route-level guard** | API route pattern from existing routes; `createClient` with service-role bypasses RLS for reads; explicit auth check in handler |
| 40% payment endpoint | New checkout endpoint vs reuse existing + amount param | **Separate endpoint** | 40% has different amount calculation, different webhook handling, and triggers delivery email/credentials; cleaner separation |

## Data Flow

```
Client (Browser)                    Stripe                         Next.js API
     │                                │                                │
     │ POST /api/payments/{id}/checkout │                               │
     ├────────────────────────────────►│                                │
     │                                 │  Stripe SDK creates           │
     │                                 │  PaymentIntent + Checkout     │
     │   ← 302 to Stripe Checkout URL  │                                │
     │                                 │                                │
     │───── User pays on Stripe ──────►│                                │
     │                                 │  POST /api/webhooks/stripe    │
     │                                 ├───────────────────────────────►│
     │                                 │                                │
     │                                 │  Validate signature            │
     │                                 │  Update payments.status        │
     │                                 │  Fire: contract PDF → Storage  │
     │                                 │  Fire: email via Resend        │
     │                                 │                                │
     │                                 │  ← 200 OK                     │
     │                                 │                                │
     │  Redirect back to app           │                                │
     │◄────────────────────────────────┤                                │
```

## Database: `payments` Table

```sql
CREATE TABLE payments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    cotizacion_id UUID REFERENCES selections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    customer_email TEXT,
    amount_60_cents INTEGER NOT NULL,
    amount_40_cents INTEGER,
    payment_intent_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    charge_id TEXT,
    checkout_url TEXT,
    contract_id TEXT,
    contract_url TEXT,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (status IN ('pending','paid_60','paid_100','failed','refunded','partial_refund')),
    partial_refund_amount INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    paid_60_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    paid_100_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    stripe_event_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
-- RLS: service_role writes (webhook), authenticated admin reads own
```

## File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `supabase/migrations/20260624_add_payments.sql` | Create | payments table DDL + indexes + RLS policies |
| `supabase/schema.sql` | Modify | Append payments table definition |
| `.env.example` | Modify | Add `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY` |
| `src/lib/stripe.service.ts` | Create | Stripe client init + `createCheckoutSession()`, `processRefund()` |
| `src/lib/email.service.ts` | Create | Resend templates: `sendPaymentConfirmation()` (60%), `sendDeliveryConfirmation()` (40%), `sendRefundConfirmation()` |
| `src/lib/contract-generator.ts` | Create | jspdf contract PDF generation (dark mode, A4, 60/40 split, terms) |
| `src/app/api/payments/[cotizacion_id]/checkout/route.ts` | Create | POST — create Stripe Checkout Session at 60%, insert payments row |
| `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts` | Create | POST — validate signature, process events, dispatch emails |
| `src/app/api/payments/[payment_id]/refund/route.ts` | Create | POST — Stripe refund, status update, refund email |
| `src/app/api/admin/payments/route.ts` | Create | GET — paginated payments list + conversion metrics (admin-only) |
| `src/app/admin/payments/page.tsx` | Create | Client component dashboard with status filter, metrics cards |
| `package.json` | Modify | Add `stripe` dependency |

## Interfaces / Contracts

```typescript
// src/lib/stripe.service.ts
export function createStripe(): Stripe;
export async function createCheckoutSession(params: {
  cotizacionId: string; totalUsd: number; customerEmail: string;
  customerName: string; successUrl: string; cancelUrl: string;
}): Promise<{ paymentIntentId: string; checkoutUrl: string; clientSecret: string }>;

// src/lib/email.service.ts
export async function sendPaymentConfirmation(params: {
  email: string; name: string; amount: number; paymentId: string;
}): Promise<void>;
export async function sendRefundConfirmation(params: {
  email: string; name: string; amount: number; paymentId: string;
}): Promise<void>;

// src/lib/contract-generator.ts
export async function generateContractPdf(params: {
  customerName: string; businessName: string; services: string[];
  totalUsd: number; paymentId: string;
}): Promise<{ contractId: string; pdfUrl: string }>;
```

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What to Test | Approach |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| Unit | `stripe.service.ts` — checkout session creation with mocked Stripe SDK | Vitest + `vi.mock("stripe")` |
| Unit | `email.service.ts` — template rendering, graceful fallback when key missing | Vitest, mock `fetch` for Resend |
| Unit | `contract-generator.ts` — PDF generation, 60/40 split calculation, edge cases | Vitest, mock Supabase storage |
| Integration | `/api/payments/{id}/checkout` — validation, idempotency, Stripe error codes | Vitest + mocked Supabase + Stripe |
| Integration | `/api/webhooks/stripe` — signature validation, event routing, duplicate prevention | Vitest with raw body parsing |
| Integration | `/api/admin/payments` — auth guards, pagination, metric aggregation | Vitest + mocked Supabase |

## Migration / Rollout

1. Run migration `20260624_add_payments.sql` to create payments table
2. Deploy API routes — checkout and webhook inactive until Stripe keys configured
3. Set `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `RESEND_API_KEY` in env
4. Register webhook endpoint in Stripe Dashboard (`/api/webhooks/stripe`)
5. Deploy admin dashboard page

Rollback: remove routes, drop table, remove `stripe` dep (matching proposal rollback plan).

## Open Questions

- [ ] Contract PDF: Supabase Storage bucket `contracts` must be created before deploy — is it already provisioned?
- [ ] 40% final payment flow: will it share the same checkout endpoint with a different amount param, or require a separate trigger? Spec requires 40% final payment email but no separate checkout endpoint defined — clarify before tasks

- [x] 4.2 `src/lib/email.service.ts` — added `sendRefundConfirmationEmail()`: HTML dark-mode template, fire-and-forget pattern

No `partial_refund_amount` column in actual DB schema — partial refunds keep original status.

**Admin API**: Two auth modes: `x-service-key` header matching `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, or `Authorization: Bearer` validated via Supabase `auth.getUser()`. Returns metrics (total_collected_cents, pending_amount_cents, conversion_rate, total_payments, paid_count) and payment list with reconstructed `checkout_url` from `checkout_session_id`.

**Admin page**: "use client" — uses `@/utils/supabase/client` for auth session, fetches from `/api/admin/payments` with Bearer token. Loading skeleton with `animate-pulse`, glassmorphism cards via `bento-panel` class, filter tabs, status badges with emoji, copy-to-clipboard for checkout links.

**DB schema note**: Actual migration doesn't have `metadata` JSONB column or `partial_refund_amount`. Refund route works within existing schema constraints — partial refunds keep original status, full refunds set 'refunded'. `checkout_url` reconstructed from `checkout_session_id` since no direct URL column exists.

### Verification
- `npm test`: 153/153 pass (14 test files, +11 refund +12 admin)
- `npm run build`: zero errors, all routes registered
- New routes: `/admin/payments`, `/api/admin/payments`, `/api/payments/[payment_id]/refund`

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `src/lib/stripe.service.ts` | Modified — added `processRefund()` function |
| `src/lib/email.service.ts` | Modified — added `sendRefundConfirmationEmail()` + template |
| `src/app/api/payments/[payment_id]/refund/route.ts` | Created (192 lines) |
| `src/app/api/admin/payments/route.ts` | Created (147 lines) |
| `src/app/admin/payments/page.tsx` | Created (296 lines) |
| `src/app/api/payments/__tests__/refund.test.ts` | Created (291 lines) |
| `src/app/api/admin/__tests__/payments.test.ts` | Created (304 lines) |
| `openspec/changes/payment-contracts-fase2/tasks.md` | Modified (marked 4.1-4.5 complete) |

### Deviations from Design
- Design showed `partial_refund` status and `partial_refund_amount` column — actual migration has neither; partial refunds keep original status, only full refunds set 'refunded'. Stripe tracks partial refund amounts.
- Design showed `checkout_url` as DB column — doesn't exist; reconstructed from `checkout_session_id` at API and page level.
- Design showed `metadata JSONB` column — doesn't exist in actual migration (PR 1 limitation); refund route doesn't depend on it.
- Auth guard uses `x-service-key` header OR Bearer token validation — matches design's "Route-level guard" via Supabase auth.

### Issues / Gotchas
- `stripe.service.ts` line 102: Stripe Refund `status` type is `string | null` — fixed with `?? "unknown"` fallback for build to pass type checking.
- Migration schema doesn't fully match the design.md table definition — partial_refund tracking relies on Stripe, not local DB.
- No `stripe_event_id` column in actual migration — PR 3 webhook uses JSONB-containing query on `metadata` column that also doesn't exist (existing tech debt from PR 1-3, not PR 4 scope).

observations.title: Vitest mockReturnValueOnce unreliable with vi.clearAllMocks in beforeEach
observations.content:
**What**: Discovered that `vi.mockReturnValueOnce()` doesn't work reliably when the mock function is called from within a `vi.mock()` factory closure AND `vi.clearAllMocks()` is called in `beforeEach`. The sequential values were consumed unexpectedly (possibly by vitest internals during module resolution). Solution: use `mockImplementation` with a manual counter (`makeResolver` helper) that returns sequential values without relying on vitest's internal `mockReturnValueOnce` queue, which seems cleared by `vi.clearAllMocks()` in vitest 4.x.

**Why**: Tests failed because `isDuplicateEvent` always returned false despite `mockReturnValueOnce` being set with `{ data: [{ id: "pay-1" }] }`. The mock resolved to `{ data: null }` instead.

**Where**: `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/__tests__/route.test.ts`, `src/app/api/payments/[cotizacion_id]/checkout/__tests__/route.test.ts`

**Learned**: Prefer `mockImplementation(() => { index++; return values[index]; })` over `mockReturnValueOnce()` when using `vi.clearAllMocks()` in beforeEach — vitest 4.x appears to clear `_mockReturnValueOnce` internal state during `mockClear()`.

observations.title: sdd/experiencia-memorable-fase3/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Experiencia Memorable — Fase 3

## Intent

Elevate the end-to-end client journey with education content, pre-meeting diagnostics, real-time project visibility, and personalized closure. Reduce sales friction, improve meeting quality, and build trust through transparency.

## Scope

### In Scope
- EducationModal: Loom embed "Explicado en 30s" on each solution card
- Pre-meeting diagnostic: 3 strategic questions post-booking, answers saved via API
- Project milestones: `project_milestones` table + MilestoneTracker component + email notifications
- WikiPDF: auto-generated closure doc (FAQs, troubleshooting, VIP support) using existing jspdf infra

### Out of Scope
- Loom account/video production (videos provided by the team, only embed logic here)
- Calendar integration beyond existing booking
- Real-time WebSocket milestone updates (polling only)
- WikiPDF customization per project (template-based V1)

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `education-modal`: Loom-embed modal triggered from solution cards, builds on existing IMPACT_TOOLTIPS data
- `pre-reunion-diagnostic`: Post-booking questionnaire page + `PATCH /api/leads/[id]/pre-reunion` endpoint + admin visibility
- `project-milestones`: `project_milestones` table linked to cotizaciones, MilestoneTracker progress bars (Configuración → Desarrollo → QA → Producción), email notifications on completion
- `wiki-pdf`: WikiPDF generator reusing `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts` patterns, downloadable from admin dashboard

### Modified Capabilities
- `meeting-scheduling`: Post-booking redirect to `/dashboard/pre-reunion/[id]`
- `service-quoting`: Solution cards integrate EducationModal trigger button

## Approach

Four independent features, ordered by dependency: (1) project_milestones DB schema first, (2) EducationModal UI on solution cards, (3) pre-reunion page + endpoint, (4) WikiPDF generator. Each feature is self-contained — none blocks another. All use existing Supabase, jspdf, and Resend infrastructure from Fase 2.

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `supabase/migrations/` | New | `project_milestones` table + RLS |
| `src/components/EducationModal.tsx` | New | Loom embed modal component |
| `src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx` | Modified | Add "Explicado en 30s" button per card |
| `src/components/MilestoneTracker.tsx` | New | Progress bar component (4 phases) |
| `src/app/dashboard/pre-reunion/[id]/` | New | Diagnostic page + PATCH endpoint |
| `src/app/dashboard/leads/[id]/` | Modified | Show MilestoneTracker below lead info |
| `src/app/dashboard/leads/[id]/client.tsx` | Modified | Wire MilestoneTracker + WikiPDF download |
| `src/lib/wiki-pdf.ts` | New | WikiPDF generator (jspdf) |
| `src/lib/notifications.ts` | Modified | Add milestone-completion email logic |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| Loom embed iframe blocks render | Low | Lazy-load modal only on click; use `loading="lazy"` |
| MilestoneTracker polling overhead | Low | Poll every 30s; Supabase RLS restricts to owner |
| WikiPDF generation timeout on large projects | Low | Generate on-demand, not auto; use existing jspdf patterns |
| Pre-reunion questions collide with existing lead data | Low | Store answers in separate JSONB column `pre_reunion_answers` |

## Rollback Plan

1. Drop `project_milestones` table via migration rollback
2. Remove `EducationModal.tsx` and revert `SolutionSelector.tsx` button additions
3. Remove `/dashboard/pre-reunion/[id]` route and PATCH endpoint
4. Remove `wiki-pdf.ts` and `wiki-pdf` API route
5. No data loss risk — all new features are additive

## Dependencies

- Existing jspdf infrastructure (`src/lib/pdf-generator.ts`, `src/lib/contract-generator.ts`)
- Supabase project (same as Fase 1/2)
- Resend email (same as Fase 2 contract emails)
- Loom account for video hosting (videos provided by team)

## Success Criteria

- [ ] "Explicado en 30s" button opens modal with Loom video on each solution card
- [ ] Post-booking submission redirects to pre-reunion page with 3 questions
- [ ] Diagnostic answers saved via `PATCH /api/leads/[id]/pre-reunion` and visible in admin
- [ ] MilestoneTracker shows 4-phase progress bar linked to cotización
- [ ] Email sent on each milestone completion via Resend
- [ ] WikiPDF generated with FAQs, troubleshooting, and VIP link; downloadable from admin
- [ ] 162 existing tests still pass; build succeeds

observations.title: sdd/experiencia-memorable-fase3/design
observations.content:
# Design: Experiencia Memorable — Fase 3

## Technical Approach

Eight features built on existing Supabase/jspdf/Resend infrastructure. All are self-contained — none blocks another. Four new components, one migration, one new page + endpoint, one PDF generator, one email template, one scoring function. All follow existing dark-mode glassmorphism patterns with framer-motion animations.

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Options | Choice | Rationale |
|----------|---------|--------|-----------|
| Pre-reunion answers storage | Separate table vs. JSONB column on `leads` | JSONB column `pre_reunion_answers` on `leads` | Matches existing `selected_solutions` pattern. Simpler queries, no JOIN needed. Proposal explicitly chose this. |
| Closing probability persistence | Calculated column vs. computed on-the-fly | On-the-fly pure function | Probability depends on real-time data (booking status, lead value, pre-reunion answers). No stale cache risk. Zero migration. |
| `project_milestones` FK target | `leads` vs. `selections` (cotizaciones) | `selections.id` (`cotizacion_id`) | Milestones track project delivery, which ties to a cotización, not the raw lead. Matches `payments.cotizacion_id` and `mvp_deployments.cotizacion_id` pattern. |
| WikiPDF storage | Download on-demand only vs. Supabase Storage | Supabase Storage + on-demand URL | Spec requires link in 40% email. Storage enables permanent URL. Follows existing wallet-passes bucket pattern. |
| Milestone email delivery | Synchronous vs. fire-and-forget | Fire-and-forget (spec compliant) | Spec says "email failure does not block milestone update". Matches existing `sendPaymentConfirmationEmail` pattern — log errors, never throw. |

## Data Flow

```
SolutionSelector ──▶ EducationModal (lazy-loads Loom iframe)
       │                      │
       │     IMPACT_TOOLTIPS (extended: video_url, text_explanation)
       │
       ▼
  BookingSection → POST /diagnose → lead created
       │
       ▼ redirect
  /dashboard/pre-reunion/[id] → PATCH /api/leads/[id]/pre-reunion → leads.pre_reunion_answers
       │
       ▼ (after meeting, admin converts)
  LeaderDetailClient → changeStatus("converted") → triggers project_milestones init (4 rows: pending)
       │
       ▼
  MilestoneTracker (polls /api/milestones?cotizacion_id=) → admin updates status
       │
       ├── status="done" → Resend email (fire-and-forget)
       └── all 4 done → WikiPDF generated → Supabase Storage → 40% email includes link
```

```
DashboardPage ──▶ useClosingMomentum(lead_id) → calculateClosingProbability(lead)
     │                                                        │
     │              Factors: pre_reunion_answers(30%) + proposal_clicks(20%) 
     │                        + value>$2K(20%) + booking_confirmed(20%) + base(10%)
     ▼
ClosingProgressBar  ◀──  closingProbability (0-100%)  
ClosingProbabilityBadge  ◀──  red(0-40) | yellow(41-70) | green(71-100) + fire >75%
```

## File Changes

### New Files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `supabase/migrations/20260625_add_project_milestones.sql` | Create `project_milestones` table + RLS + `leads.pre_reunion_answers` JSONB column |
| `src/lib/closing-probability.ts` | `calculateClosingProbability(lead, selection)` — pure function, returns 0-100 |
| `src/hooks/useClosingMomentum.ts` | React hook: fetches lead data, calls scoring function, returns `{probability, badgeColor, animated}` |
| `src/components/EducationModal.tsx` | Glassmorphism modal with Loom iframe / text fallback. Accepts `solutionId`, `videoUrl?`, `textExplanation?`, `onClose` |
| `src/components/MilestoneTracker.tsx` | 4-bar progress component. Props: `cotizacionId`. Polls milestones via Supabase client. |
| `src/components/ClosingProgressBar.tsx` | Gradient bar (blue→indigo), framer-motion `animate={{ width }}`. Props: `probability`. With tooltip + fire at >75% |
| `src/components/ClosingProbabilityBadge.tsx` | Badge with color + label. Props: `probability`. |
| `src/app/dashboard/pre-reunion/[id]/page.tsx` | Server component: fetches lead, renders diagnostic form |
| `src/app/dashboard/pre-reunion/[id]/client.tsx` | Client component: form with 3 questions, validation, PATCH submit |
| `src/app/api/leads/[id]/pre-reunion/route.ts` | PATCH endpoint: validates auth, updates `leads.pre_reunion_answers` |
| `src/lib/wiki-pdf.ts` | `generateWikiPDF(solutions, businessName)` → Buffer. Reuses jspdf palette from `contract-generator.ts`. |
| `src/app/api/milestones/route.ts` | GET (list by cotizacion_id) + POST (create) + PATCH (update status). Service role auth. |

### Modified Files
| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx` | Add "� Explicado en 30s" button below each card; wire EducationModal open/close state |
| `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` | Add `ClosingProgressBar` + `ClosingProbabilityBadge` to each lead row |
| `src/app/dashboard/leads/[id]/page.tsx` | Fetch milestones + pre_reunion_answers; pass to client |
| `src/app/dashboard/leads/[id]/client.tsx` | Render MilestoneTracker, diagnostic answers section, WikiPDF download button |
| `src/app/propuesta/[id]/page.tsx` | Fetch milestones; render MilestoneTracker (public read-only view) |
| `src/lib/email.service.ts` | Add `sendMilestoneEmail()` function + extend `build40Template()` with WikiPDF link |
| `supabase/schema.sql` | Add `project_milestones` table + `leads.pre_reunion_answers` column |

## Interfaces / Contracts

```typescript
// closing-probability.ts
interface ClosingFactors {
  preReunionAnswers: boolean;   // +30%
  proposalClicks: number;       // +20% if >0
  leadValue: number;            // +20% if >2000
  bookingConfirmed: boolean;    // +20%
}
function calculateClosingProbability(lead: LeadData, selection?: SelectionData): number;

// EducationModal.tsx
interface EducationModalProps {
  solutionId: string;
  videoUrl?: string;
  textExplanation?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}

// PATCH /api/leads/[id]/pre-reunion
// Body: { pre_reunion_answers: { q1: string, q2: string, q3: string } }
// Response: 200 { success: true } | 401 { error: "Unauthorized" }

// project_milestones row
interface ProjectMilestone {
  id: string; cotizacion_id: string;
  phase: 'env_setup' | 'dev' | 'qa' | 'production';
  status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'done';
  started_at?: string; completed_at?: string;
  notes?: string;
}
```

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What | Approach |
|-------|------|----------|
| Unit | `calculateClosingProbability()` | Vitest — test all factor combinations, edge cases (null lead, missing fields) |
| Unit | `generateWikiPDF()` | Vitest — verify PDF buffer output, section presence per solution type |
| Integration | `PATCH /api/leads/[id]/pre-reunion` | Vitest + Supertest — auth check, validation, successful save |
| Integration | `src/app/api/milestones/route.ts` | Vitest — CRUD operations, RLS enforcement, email trigger on "done" |
| Component | `EducationModal` | @testing-library/react — open/close, ESC key, focus trap, video/fallback rendering |
| Component | `MilestoneTracker` | @testing-library/react — all statuses, completion banner, animation states |
| Component | `ClosingProgressBar` + `ClosingProbabilityBadge` | @testing-library/react — percentage display, gradient, emoji threshold |
| E2E | Pre-reunion flow | Playwright — booking → redirect → fill → submit → admin visibility |

## Migration / Rollout

1. Run migration `20260625_add_project_milestones.sql` (adds table + column; no destructive changes)
2. Deploy new components + routes (additive, no existing page breaks)
3. Update `SolutionSelector` with EducationModal trigger (backward compatible)
4. WikiPDF on-demand only — no auto-generation until admin triggers final delivery

Rollback: drop `project_milestones` table, drop `pre_reunion_answers` column, remove new routes. Zero data loss risk.

## Open Questions

None. All decisions resolved per proposal + specs.

observations.title: sdd/solucion-curation-fase4/proposal
observations.content:
# Proposal: Solución Curation — Fase 4

## Intent

Evolve the solution catalog from a static 7-solution JSON file to a dynamic, learnable system. When a client needs something not in the base catalog, Juan can capture it as a curated template via AI-assisted extraction from lead notes.

## Scope

### In Scope
- **`solution_templates` table**: persists curated solutions with same shape as `experience-base.json` solutions, plus `is_core` flag
- **`POST /api/admin/curate-solution`**: receives `lead_id` + `solution_notes`, uses multi-provider AI (Claude→OpenAI→local) to generate structured solution JSON matching `SolutionSchema`, inserts into `solution_templates`
- **Admin UI button**: "✨ Convertir en Plantilla" on lead detail page → modal with AI-generated fields → edit → publish
- **Provider merge**: extend `analyze-lead.service` to union core solutions (`experience-base.json`) with `is_core=true` templates from DB. Local provider already operates on `ExperienceBase.solutions[]` — feed it the merged array
- **Backward compatibility**: `SolutionSelector` and existing tests unchanged. Core solutions from JSON + dynamic from DB coexist

### Out of Scope
- Editing/deleting/listing templates via admin dashboard (future)
- Syncing curated templates back into `experience-base.json` (future)
- Client-facing self-service curation
- Migrating existing Fase 0-3 code to new table

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `solution-curation`: Admin endpoint + UI for capturing AI-generated solution templates from lead notes, persisting to `solution_templates` table

### Modified Capabilities
- `ai-lead-analysis`: `analyze-lead.service` SHALL merge core solutions from `experience-base.json` with `is_core=true` rows from `solution_templates` before passing to providers. Local provider uses the merged array. Claude/OpenAI prompts include dynamic solutions in context

## Approach

1. **Migration**: new `solution_templates` table mirroring `SolutionSchema` fields + `is_core BOOLEAN DEFAULT false` + `created_at`
2. **API route**: `/api/admin/curate-solution` (auth gated). Receives `{ lead_id, solution_notes }`. Calls AI provider chain to generate `{ name, description, hours, setup_cost, monthly_maintenance, roi_per_month, tech_stack, industries, keywords }`. Validates with Zod against `SolutionSchema` shape. Inserts into `solution_templates`
3. **Service extension**: `analyzeLeadInput()` fetches `is_core=true` from `solution_templates` via service_role client, merges into `DB.solutions` array before provider dispatch. Cache merged array per request (no global cache to avoid stale reads)
4. **UI**: button on `LeadDetailClient` that opens modal. Modal shows AI-generated JSON (editable fields). On publish, calls `POST /api/admin/curate-solution`

## Affected Areas

| Area | Impact | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `supabase/migrations/` | New | `20260625_add_solution_templates.sql` |
| `src/lib/analyze-lead.service.ts` | Modified | Merge core + DB templates before provider call |
| `src/app/api/admin/curate-solution/route.ts` | New | POST handler with auth + AI + insert |
| `src/app/dashboard/leads/[id]/client.tsx` | Modified | "Convertir en Plantilla" button + modal |
| `src/lib/ai/prompts.ts` | Modified | Add curation prompt variant |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| AI generates invalid solution fields | Med | Zod validation rejects bad output; retry with fallback provider |
| DB merge increases latency | Low | Service role query is < 50ms; cache per request |
| `is_core` confusion (which solutions are "real") | Low | Only admin sets `is_core=true`; default `false` for WIP |

## Rollback Plan

1. Remove `solution_templates` table (migration is additive)
2. Revert `analyze-lead.service` merge logic — providers fall back to `experience-base.json` only
3. Hide admin button via feature flag or comment-out

## Dependencies

- Supabase `service_role` key available in server context (already used in `admin/payments` and lead detail page)
- Multi-provider AI chain already operational (Claude, OpenAI, local)

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Admin can submit lead notes → AI generates structured solution → saved to `solution_templates`
- [ ] `analyze-lead.service` includes curated templates alongside core 7 solutions
- [ ] `SolutionSelector` renders dynamic solutions without regressions (198 existing tests pass)
- [ ] Min 12 new tests covering API route, merge logic, and UI modal
- [ ] Migration runs cleanly with `supabase db push`

# SDD Specs: Solución Curation — Fase 4

## Domain: solution-curation (NEW)

### Requirement: Solution Templates Table
The system MUST maintain a `solution_templates` table with columns: `id` (text PK), `name`, `description`, `hours`, `setup_cost`, `monthly_maintenance`, `roi_per_month`, `tech_stack` (text[]), `industries` (text[]), `keywords` (text[]), `is_core` (boolean default false), and `created_at` (timestamptz default now()).

**Scenarios**: Table exists with correct schema, all required columns with correct types, `id` is PK, `is_core` defaults to false.

### Requirement: Curate Solution Endpoint
The system MUST expose `POST /api/admin/curate-solution`, receiving `{ lead_id: string, solution_notes: string }` and returning `{ solution: SolutionSchema, status: "created" }`. Auth-gated to admin users. On success, inserts into `solution_templates`.

**Scenarios**: Valid curation inserts into DB, missing lead_id returns 400, missing solution_notes returns 400, duplicate id returns 409 conflict.

### Requirement: AI Solution Generation
The system SHALL use multi-provider AI chain (Claude → OpenAI → local) to analyze `solution_notes` and generate structured JSON matching `SolutionSchema`. Prompt must return: `name`, `description`, `hours`, `setup_cost`, `monthly_maintenance`, `roi_per_month`, `tech_stack`, `industries`, `keywords` (matching `experience-base.json` format). Zod-validated before insertion.

**Scenarios**: AI generates correct format matching experience-base.json keywords, AI failure triggers provider fallback, invalid AI output rejected by Zod (no insert, server-side log).

## Domain: ai-lead-analysis (DELTA)

### ADDED: Curated Solution Merge
The system SHALL fetch curated solutions from `solution_templates` (where `is_core=true`) on each analysis request and merge with core solutions from `experience-base.json` before passing to providers. Deduplicate by `id` (core wins). Merge must not add >50ms latency. Local provider operates on merged array. Claude/OpenAI prompts include dynamic curated solutions.

**Scenarios**: Merge core + curated solutions, curated only match when no core solution matches sector, deduplication by id preserves core version, empty curated table preserves existing behavior (198 tests pass), merge latency under 50ms.

### MODIFIED: Lead Analysis Endpoint
Updated to reference merged pool of core solutions + curated templates instead of `experience-base.json` only. All 3 existing scenarios preserved. Added note that curated templates are included in local provider's solution pool.

observations.title: sdd/solucion-curation-fase4/design
observations.content:
# Design: Solución Curation — Fase 4

## Technical Approach

Extend the solution catalog from a static 7-solution JSON file to a dynamic, learnable system. Admin flow: POST `/api/admin/curate-solution` with `lead_id` + `solution_notes` → AI provider chain generates structured solution JSON → Zod validates against `SolutionSchema` → persisted to `solution_templates`. On every analysis, `analyze-lead.service` fetches `is_core=true` rows via service_role, merges with core solutions (`experience-base.json`), deduplicates (core wins), and passes merged array to providers. Admin UI: "✨ Convertir en Plantilla" button on lead detail → modal → edit → publish. Backward compatible: empty table preserves existing behavior.

## Architecture Decisions

| Decision | Option | Tradeoff | Decision |
|----------|--------|----------|----------|
| PK type | UUID vs text | UUID auto-generated but opaque. Text human-readable, matches experience-base.json convention | Text — solution IDs like `"fidelizacion-wallet"` |
| AI provider | New chain vs reuse existing | Reuse: zero new infra, same fallback behavior. New: isolated but duplicates | Reuse multi-provider chain (local → claude → openai) from analyze-lead |
| Merge strategy | Global cache vs per-request query | Cache: stale reads. Per-request: fresh but extra query (~50ms max) | Per-request service_role direct query, no cache |
| Admin UI | Separate page vs modal | Modal: context-preserving, fewer clicks. Page: more space | Modal in lead detail with editable AI-generated fields |
| Validation | Custom vs Zod | Zod: reuse `SolutionSchema` from experience-base, type-safe, same contracts | Zod `SolutionSchema` from `experience-base.schema.ts` |

## Data Flow

```
Admin UI (client.tsx)         API Route                Supabase
     │                           │                        │
     │ POST /api/admin/          │                        │
     │   curate-solution ───────→│                        │
     │                           │  AI chain (notes)      │
     │                           │  → structured JSON     │
     │                           │  Zod validate          │
     │                           │  INSERT ──────────────→│ solution_templates
     │←── {solution, "created"} │←──────── row ──────────│
     │                                                      analyze-lead.service
     │                           service_role SELECT ─────→│ is_core=true
     │                           ←────── rows ─────────────│
     │                           merge(core, curated)      │
     │                           → providers(merged pool)  │
```

## File Changes

| File | Action | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `supabase/migrations/20260625_add_solution_templates.sql` | Create | `solution_templates` table (text PK, SolutionSchema columns, `is_core`) |
| `src/app/api/admin/curate-solution/route.ts` | Create | POST handler: auth gate, AI chain, Zod validate, DB insert |
| `src/app/api/admin/curate-solution/__tests__/route.test.ts` | Create | Min 8 tests: auth, validation, insert, conflict, AI fallback |
| `supabase/schema.sql` | Modify | Append `solution_templates` DDL + index + RLS |
| `src/lib/analyze-lead.service.ts` | Modify | Fetch `is_core=true` rows, merge with core before provider call |
| `src/lib/ai/prompts.ts` | Modify | Add `CURATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT` for solution generation |
| `src/app/dashboard/leads/[id]/client.tsx` | Modify | "✨ Convertir en Plantilla" button + editable modal |

## Interfaces / Contracts

```typescript
// POST /api/admin/curate-solution
// Request
{ lead_id: string; solution_notes: string }

// Response (200)
{
  solution: { id, name, description, hours, setup_cost,
    monthly_maintenance, roi_per_month, tech_stack, industries, keywords };
  status: "created";
}

// solution_templates row
{ id: text PK, name text, description text, hours int, setup_cost int,
  monthly_maintenance int, roi_per_month text, tech_stack text[],
  industries text[], keywords text[], is_core bool DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now() }
```

`analyze-lead.service` internal contract: `fetchCuratedSolutions()` returns `Solution[]` → deduplicate by id (core wins) → pass merged to provider chain.

## Testing Strategy

| Layer | What to Test | Approach |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| Unit (API) | Auth rejection, input validation, DB insert, duplicate conflict, AI fallback | Vitest + vi.mock Supabase (same pattern as `payments.test.ts`) |
| Unit (Service) | Empty curated → core-only, duplicates → core preserved, curated-only match | Extend existing `analyze-lead.service.test.ts` |
| Integration | POST → verify DB row | Manual or future Playwright |

## Migration / Rollout

- Migration is additive (`CREATE TABLE`). Rollback: `DROP TABLE solution_templates`.
- API route is standalone. Rollback: delete route file.
- `analyze-lead.service` merge is additive — empty table = existing behavior preserved.
- Admin button hidden behind existing auth.

## Open Questions

- None — all decisions captured above.

observations.title: Removed duplicate Name/Email/Phone fields from Step 4 of SolutionSelector
observations.content:
**What**: Removed redundant Name/Email/Phone input fields that were appearing in Step 4 (Sesión de Arquitectura Estratégica) of the landing page multi-step form.
**Why**: These fields were already filled by the user in Step 1's "Tus datos" panel. Showing them again in Step 4 was a UX duplication.
**Where**: src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx — removed the `<div className="mb-5 grid...">` block containing the three fields from the `currentStep === 4` ternary branch (was around lines 1692-1696). Also removed the now-unnecessary fragment wrapper `<>`.
**Learned**: The multi-step form has contact fields in Step 1 (lines 1550-1577) and was redundantly rendering them again at Step 4.

observations.title: Added inter-step navigation to landing page multi-step form
observations.content:
**What**: Made step indicators clickable and added "← Volver" back-navigation buttons to Steps 2, 3, and 4 of the landing page multi-step form.
**Why**: User wanted to move freely between steps to correct or update data without losing filled information. Data already persisted in React state — only navigation was missing.
**Where**: src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx
- Step indicators (lines 1182-1194): converted circle divs to `<button>` elements with `onClick={() => setCurrentStep(step)}`, added hover/active/current-ring styles, aria-label and aria-current.
- Step 2 (line ~1390): replaced conditional `hasSelection`-only div with a flex container that always shows "← Volver" and conditionally shows "Siguiente →".
- Step 3 (line ~1689): changed `currentStep >= 3` guard to `currentStep === 3` to hide the "Continuar" button on Step 4; added "← Volver" button alongside it.
- Step 4 (line ~1714): added "← Volver" button above BookingSection wrapped in a fragment.
**Learned**: The Step 3 "Continuar" button had `currentStep >= 3` which incorrectly showed it on Step 4 as well. Changed to `currentStep === 3`.

observations.title: Redesigned Step 4 with two-column proposal + calendar layout
observations.content:
**What**: Redesigned Step 4 (Sesión de Arquitectura Estratégica) into a two-column layout: left column shows a personalized proposal summary with selected solutions and savings, right column shows the booking calendar. Also removed all "← Volver" buttons (navigation is now only via clickable step indicators) and separated Step 3 and Step 4 rendering blocks so they no longer share content.
**Why**: User wanted clean step-to-step navigation via step indicators only, no back buttons. Step 4 was incorrectly showing Step 3's "Proyección de inversión" content because both shared `currentStep >= 3`. User chose the "ambitious" two-column redesign option for Step 4.
**Where**: src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx
- Step indicators: converted to clickable buttons with ring highlight on current step
- Step 2: restored simple "Siguiente" button without Volver
- Step 3: gated to `currentStep === 3` only, removed Volver, only "Continuar" button
- Step 4: new two-column layout (`grid-cols-2`). Left: "Paso final" label, heading, solution summary with checkmarks, savings total, reassurance message. Right: BookingSection calendar.
**Learned**: The `currentStep >= 3` guard was the root cause of step 4 showing step 3 content. Always use exact step matching (`===`) for mutually exclusive step rendering.

observations.title: Sequential calendar flow + skipIntro + equal height columns in Step 4
observations.content:
**What**: Three changes to BookingSection and Step 4: (1) Sequential calendar flow — calendar → time ranges → sub-slots → confirmation, each step replacing the previous with AnimatePresence transitions. (2) skipIntro prop — when true, BookingSection starts at phase 2 (calendar) directly, skipping the "Analizando viabilidad" animation. (3) Equal-height two-column layout in Step 4.
**Why**: User wanted: calendar not to look small by hiding previous steps progressively; "Analizando viabilidad" to only show on first visit to Step 4; left and right columns in Step 4 to have equal height on desktop.
**Where**: 
- src/components/BookingSection.tsx: Added skipIntro prop, phase init uses skipIntro ? 2 : 0. Phase 2 redesigned into 4 sequential steps (2a calendar, 2b time ranges, 2c sub-slots, 2d confirmation) using AnimatePresence mode="wait". Fixed TypeScript narrowing issue with selRef capture.
- src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx: Added hasVisitedStep4 state + useEffect to track first visit. Passed skipIntro={hasVisitedStep4} to BookingSection. Right column uses flex flex-col + flex-1 for equal height.
**Learned**: The `{!selectedDate && (...)}` conditional in JSX narrows TypeScript's type of selectedDate to null for the entire block, including nested callbacks like .map(). Fixed by capturing the value in a const before the conditional.

observations.title: Fixed calendar box shrinking with min-height and flex layout
observations.content:
**What**: Added min-h-[400px] and flex layout to BookingSection Phase 2 container to prevent the calendar box from shrinking when transitioning between steps (calendar → ranges → sub-slots → confirm).
**Why**: AnimatePresence mode="wait" adjusts container height to each step's content height. Steps like time ranges and sub-slots are shorter than the calendar, causing the box to visibly shrink. Fixed by setting a minimum height and using flex-1 on each step with justify-center on shorter steps.
**Where**: src/components/BookingSection.tsx — bento-panel now has `flex flex-col min-h-[400px]`. Calendar step has `flex-1`. Ranges and subslots steps have `flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center`. Confirm step has `flex-1 space-y-5`.

observations.title: Added hourly value input UX and step-by-step form validation
observations.content:
**What**: (1) Changed hourlyValue input to accept empty value with placeholder="15" as suggestion. Effective value defaults to 15 when empty. (2) Added step-by-step validation that blocks advancing with goToStep(), shows inline error messages per step, and highlights empty fields with red borders.
**Why**: User wanted: input that clears on focus with default suggestion; validation that prevents advancing with missing fields; clear user-friendly error indication.
**Where**: src/components/SolutionSelector.tsx
- hourlyValue state: changed from useState(15) to useState<number|''>(''), added effectiveHourly = hourlyValue || 15
- New: validateStep(step) function, stepErrors state, goToStep(step) with validation loop, fieldError(step, value) helper
- Step indicators: onChange uses goToStep instead of setCurrentStep
- Step 2 "Siguiente" and Step 3 "Continuar" buttons: use goToStep, always visible with error display below
- FloatingInput component: added hasError prop with red border styling
- Step 1 inputs (painDescription textarea, businessName, clientName, email): conditional red border via fieldError
- Error banner: shown below step title for current step's errors
**Learned**: The goToStep function validates intermediate steps when jumping ahead (e.g., step 1→3 validates steps 1 and 2), but always allows going backward. Error state clears on successful advance. template literal className with ternary works for conditional error classes.

observations.title: Fixed logout redirect, pre-reunion auth bypass, and re-submission prevention
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed three issues: (1) Logout redirecting to Supabase API URL instead of app URL causing "No API key found" error. (2) Pre-reunion diagnostic page requiring login when it should be public for leads. (3) Pre-reunion form allowing re-submission when lead already completed it.
**Why**: (1) logout/route.ts POST handler used NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL as the redirect base, hitting Supabase's REST API. (2) middleware.ts protected all /dashboard routes, including /dashboard/pre-reunion which is inside the (public) route group. (3) Client component showed form even when pre_reunion_answers existed.
**Where**:
- src/app/auth/logout/route.ts: Both POST and GET now accept Request, use request.url origin for redirect. Removed hardcoded sharp-stack.cl-jmunoz.workers.dev URL.
- src/middleware.ts: Added isPreReunion check, auth bypass for /dashboard/pre-reunion/* paths.
- src/app/(public)/dashboard/pre-reunion/[id]/client.tsx: Added early return for hasExisting showing "Ya completaste el diagnóstico" message instead of form. Removed dead code (hasExisting notice and button ternary).
**Learned**: Next.js route groups ((public)) don't affect middleware path matching — middleware sees the full URL path including the group segment. Need explicit path exclusions.

observations.title: Integrated Google Calendar API for real-time meeting availability
observations.content:
**What**: Integrated Google Calendar API for real-time meeting availability. Created service account client (lib/google-calendar.ts), API endpoint (/api/calendar/availability), updated BookingSection to fetch dynamic slots, and updated docs.
**Why**: Replace hardcoded availability with real Google Calendar free/busy data. System now shows only truly available time ranges and 30-minute slots based on Juan's actual calendar.
**Where**:
- src/lib/google-calendar.ts: NEW — Service account JWT auth via googleapis, freeBusy query, slot generation from WORKING_HOURS config (morning 09-12, midday 12-14, afternoon 14-18). Falls back to empty availability on error.
- src/app/api/calendar/availability/route.ts: NEW — GET endpoint with date param validation.
- src/components/BookingSection.tsx: Added CalendarAvailability state, useEffect fetch on date select, loading step in AnimatePresence, dynamic timeSlots/subSlots via useMemo, falls back to hardcoded TIME_SLOTS/SUB_SLOTS when API unavailable.
- .env.example: Added GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL, GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY, GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.
- README.md: Added Google Calendar to stack table and file structure.
- openspec/specs/meeting-scheduling/spec.md: Added Google Calendar real-time availability requirement with scenarios.
**Learned**: googleapis package works in Next.js API routes (Node.js runtime). Service account needs calendar.readonly scope and the service account email must be added to the target calendar with "See only free/busy" permission. FreeBusy endpoint doesn't read event details, only busy slots.

observations.title: Fix _calculate_vacations incomplete cycle cutoff date
observations.content:
**What**: Fixed the incomplete cycle calculation in _calculate_vacations to use the employee's admission day (cutoff date) and 30-day legal month instead of max_to_date + 1 and calendar days
**Why**: The code was using max_to_date + 1 as the period start, which didn't align with the employee's cutoff date (day of admission). This caused the incomplete cycle to start too early, factor > 1, and add ~2 extra vacation days.
**Where**: remunerations/api_ec.py — lines 8962-8969 in _calculate_vacations
**Learned**: In Ecuador, vacation months are 30 legal days, not calendar days. The cutoff date for vacation cycles is the employee's admission day (cumple mes). p_start must be the max of (max_to_date + 1, last_cutoff_date) to avoid going backwards.

observations.title: Fix end_date fallback to use employee.unlink_date
observations.content:
**What**: Changed end_date fallback in GetDataSettlementsEC.list() to use employee.unlink_date before pendulum.now()
**Why**: When unlink_date is not passed in query params, end_date defaulted to pendulum.now() (today) instead of the actual termination date, causing all settlement calculations to use the wrong date.
**Where**: remunerations/api_ec.py — lines 7710-7722 in GetDataSettlementsEC.list()
**Learned**: The employee fetch was after end_date processing — moved it earlier to allow employee.unlink_date as a fallback. This ensures settlement calculations use the correct cut-off date even when the frontend omits unlink_date.

observations.title: Optimized Query 2 in _calculate_vacations
observations.content:
**What**: Separated max_to_date query from overlap reduction loop in _calculate_vacations, added to_date__gt filter
**Why**: The original combined loop iterated ALL assignations (~120 for 10yr employee) to track max_to_date and check overlap. Now max_to_date is a cheap single-value query, and the overlap loop only processes assignations with to_date > end_date (typically 0-1).
**Where**: remunerations/api_ec.py — lines 8796-8828 in _calculate_vacations
**Learned**: The `to_date__gt=self.end_date` filter on the overlap query eliminates the need to check in Python. max_to_date is obtained via a separate `ORDER BY -to_date LIMIT 1` query which uses the DB index efficiently.

observations.title: Session summary: hcmfront
observations.content:
## Goal
Corregir y optimizar el cálculo de vacaciones en `_calculate_vacations` para liquidaciones Ecuador

## Instructions
- Cambios quirúrgicos, intervenir lo mínimo posible
- Siempre reducir queries a la base de datos, el mejor código es el que no se ejecuta

## Discoveries
- El mes legal en Ecuador es de 30 días, no calendario
- La fecha de corte para el ciclo incompleto es el día de admisión (cumple mes)
- `self.end_date` en `SettlementCalculationEC.__init__` ya normaliza a `pendulum.date`, el `hasattr(..., 'hour')` es código muerto
- `d_end = self.end_date` es suficiente (el constructor ya normaliza)
- El `max_to_date` puede obtenerse O(1) del primer registro ordenado por `-to_date` sin query separada

## Accomplished
- ✅ Fix: `p_start` ahora se alinea con la última fecha de corte (día de admisión) en vez de `max_to_date + 1`
- ✅ Fix: denominador del factor cambiado a 30 (mes legal) en vez de días calendario
- ✅ Fix: `end_date` en `GetDataSettlementsEC.list()` ahora usa `employee.unlink_date` como fallback si no se envía en query params
- ✅ Cleanup: eliminado `hasattr(..., 'hour')` código muerto en d_end y date_admission
- ✅ Cleanup: eliminados 4 prints de debug
- ✅ Cleanup: eliminadas variables intermedias redundantes (cutoff_day, last_cutoff separado)
- ✅ Cleanup: renombrado d_end → unlink_date para claridad
- ✅ Optimización: 1 sola query, sin JOINs, max_to_date O(1) del primer registro

## Next Steps
- Probar con datos reales para verificar que los valores cuadren con lo esperado
